summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new SSE streaming chat endpoint and live-animation UI. Backend: all 8 targeted pytest tests passed (root, /auth/me unauth 401, invalid session_id 401, seeded /auth/me, chat non-stream message+history, chat clear, chat/stream unauth 401, chat/stream SSE full flow). SSE flow test verified Content-Type text/event-stream, and receipt of 'user', 'start', >=1 'delta', and 'done' events (elena message_id matches, done text non-empty, history contains both messages) in under 60s. Frontend: seeded session_token cookie loads dashboard; dashboard-player-container renders with dashboard-player-image; sending a message via chat-input+chat-send-button triggered a streaming bubble with blinking gold caret, header status switched to 'pensando en ti'/'hablando en vivo', and the top-left player badge 'ELENA ESTÁ HABLANDO' appeared during streaming. Final Elena message finalized in the message list after stream completed. Clear button still resets to the single welcome message. Screenshots captured for initial, streaming, and final states.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py chat_stream: model string 'gpt-5.4' is used for streaming — confirmed working via emergentintegrations, but ensure this identifier remains valid in the emergent LLM key catalogue.
ChatPanel parseSSEStream splits buffer on '\n\n' and drops any partial trailing block until next chunk arrives — correct SSE framing.
Dashboard auto-loads only the latest 'video' from gallery; if user has only photos, ElenaPlayer keeps default static portrait (which still shows breathing/blink/parallax) — matches design intent.

ElenaPlayer blink overlay is a full-width horizontal dark bar across the eye region — works with default portrait but its Y-position (32%) may not perfectly line up with eyes on arbitrary user-generated photos/videos. Minor cosmetic risk.
test_credentials: Backend pytest seeds via pymongo fixture. Frontend used cookie session_token=test_session_fe_1786400209483 for user bryanugalde290@gmail.com seeded via mongosh.
seed_data_creation: One user + one session_token seeded per test run; cleaned up in fixture teardown for backend. Frontend seed cookie not cleaned automatically (harmless in preview env).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Streaming works end-to-end. If reviewing further: the streaming Elena bubble uses data-testid=chat-message-<uuid> that matches the 'start' event's message_id — a single stable id from stream start through finalization. The badge on player is inside dashboard-player-container and reads 'ELENA ESTÁ HABLANDO' or 'ELENA ESTÁ PENSANDO'. Header status text lives inside data-testid=dashboard-header. Photo/video generation tests (test_generate_photo, test_generate_video_pending) are still present but were skipped in this iteration to save time; they passed in iteration_1.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All new SSE streaming and live-animation features working as designed.
